description: This file defines the SearchFragment class for the search UI in an Android notes app, handling search input, navigation, and UI updates.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing the search UI, handling user input, navigation, and displaying search results.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up search input listener, and manages focus based on arguments.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on notes, navigating to the editor with animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click events on notes, showing a menu.

methods.name: onNotesChanged
methods.description: Updates UI indicators and list when the set of notes changes.
